## Summary

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue, if any.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm ci` and `npm run verify` pass.
- [ ] Relevant browser, Docker, or packaging checks pass (or explain why they do not apply).
- [ ] Documentation reflects changes to controls, APIs, model assumptions, or setup.
- [ ] No credentials, local checkpoints, or private session files are included.

For model changes, include seeds and experiment results; distinguish observations from claims.
